title: elytrigia repens var. glauca
intro: Elytrigia repens var. glauca, commonly known as creeping meadow grass, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it beneficial for treating cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Elytrigia repens var. glauca include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, digestive issues, and urinary tract problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
